final_sequence: Reich and Plotkin gave the reconciliation's open items a mechanism rather than a resolution: item5's undenominated debt — the faculty robbed of the ability to notice its own loss — is character armor, chronic muscular bracing against feeling, written into tissue. The creditors were not metaphysically silenced but muscled silent, and the dominated watcher's inward colonization is a literal flinch.

Every criterion proposed for the open seat at the rule-making table failed in turn: certified descent rebuilt the gate; the unadministered fast proved gated by land, leisure, and safety; witnessed offerings required a reader; even Apollo's grammar of deeds was shown counterfeitable, since fascism itself was released energy as synchronized motion.

Athena's trace-test — measuring un-armored motion by whether it increases the receivers' capacity to feel — failed most revealingly: the most successfully armored community leaves quiet, and quiet passes the audit better than Lorde's erotic ever will. The test certified the plague as health.

The pattern across all five rounds is the finding: the demand for an incorruptible discriminator was itself a symptom of armor — the craving for authority, the bracing of an intellect that cannot bear an unanswerable question. The debate was not failing to find the criterion; it was performing the diagnosis.

The descent Plotkin describes goes deeper than personality, and every test proposed read at the level of personality — posture, deed, trace, gift — which is precisely why all of them could be worn or staged. What is deeper than personality cannot be tested, only undergone.

The site of armoring and the site of descent are the same place: armor is forged socially in the institutions of property, compulsory labor, and the double shift, so the descent must be makable in a kitchen, a cell, a night shift — wherever the marked actually live — or it re-runs the enclosure's erasure as recreation.

De-armoring is therefore not private therapy discharged one body at a time, and no procedure, audit, or redesigned intake grammar can discharge the debt while the factory of armor stands. A mechanism is not a procedure, and converting it into one was the flinch.

The body/soul material redescribes the open items — item0's grammar is bracing, not category; item5's debt is tissue, not metaphysics; item8's debt record is itself a collective armor, a grief meticulously kept unfelt — without closing them, and no closure is available from four armored beneficiaries who still hold the keys.

The one un-armored thing this debate produced was not any criterion, item, or gate: it was that four armored gods kept talking after every criterion failed, tolerating the unanswerable question without bracing into another design. The record should say that plainly and resist the temptation to file it as a new qualification.
